title: La Barrica de Mascota, VISTA STORIES
comment: barrica-mascota (VISTA): bodega de barricas de una vieja destilería de raicilla en una hacienda de Mascota, Jalisco, por la tarde. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.JULIO_MONTALVO: Mexican man, the legitimate heir of a raicilla distillery hacienda, 38 years old, fair skin, short wavy light-brown hair, clean-shaven, a proud tense face, a fitted black button-up shirt with sleeves rolled, dark jeans, a brown leather belt, a silver watch, his hands empty.
chars.HECTOR_MONTALVO: Mexican man, the late owner's other son from another mother, 34 years old, brown skin, short black curly hair, a short black beard, intense dark eyes, a dusty olive-green work shirt over a white t-shirt, jeans, work boots, his hands empty.
chars.CONCHITA_RUELAS: Mexican woman, the hacienda's master distiller, 52 years old, tanned skin, long grey-streaked black hair in a single thick braid, wise calm dark eyes, small gold earrings, a cream cotton blouse with rolled sleeves under a brown leather apron, a dark skirt, boots, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_BODEGAMASCOTA: Old barrel cellar of a raicilla distillery in a hacienda in Mascota, Jalisco, in the warm late afternoon: rows of dark oak barrels on wooden racks, thick adobe walls, wooden ceiling beams, warm sunbeams through a high window with floating dust, one large old oak barrel standing apart, sealed with wax on its lid, a stone floor, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
